n110880.source: Plutarchus, Adversus Colotem (1107d-1127e), ed. Grēgorios N. Vernardakēs, Leipzig 1895 (Perseus)

n110880.source: Dionysius Halicarnassensis, De Demosthenis dictione, ed. Hermann Usener and Ludwig Radermacher, Leipzig 1899 (Perseus)

n110881.source: Diodorus Siculus, Bibliotheca historica (lib. 1-20), ed. C. H. Oldfather and Charles L. Sherman and C. Bradford Welles, Cambridge, Mass. 1946 (Perseus)

n110882.source: Theophrastus, Characteres, ed. Hermann Diels, Oxford 1909 (Perseus)
lines: δόξειεν δʼ ἂν εἶναι ἡ ὀλιγαρχία φιλαρχία τις ἰσχύος καὶ κέρδους γλιχομένη, ὁ δὲ ὀλιγαρχικὸς τοιοῦτός τις, οἷος τοῦ δήμου βουλευομένου, τίνας τῷ ἄρχοντι προσαιρήσονται τῆς πομπῆς τοὺς συνεπιμελησομένους, παρελθὼν ἀποφήνασθαι, ὡς δεῖ αὐτοκράτορας τούτους εἶναι, κἂν ἄλλοι προβάλλωνται δέκα, λέγειν·

n110882.source: Polybius, Historiae, ed. Theodor Büttner-Wobst, Leipzig 1893 (Perseus)

n110882.source: Philodemus, Περὶ εὐσεβείας (pars i) (P. Herc. 229, 247/242, 437/452, 1077, 1098, 1610, 1788), ed. D. Obbink, Oxford 1996

n110882.source: Plutarchus, Marius, ed. Bernadotte Perrin, Cambridge, Mass. 1920 (Perseus)

n110882.source: Plutarchus, Eumenes, ed. Bernadotte Perrin, Cambridge, Mass. 1919 (Perseus)

n110882.source: Plutarchus, Cicero, ed. Bernadotte Perrin, Cambridge, Mass. 1919 (Perseus)

n110883.source: Origenes, Contra Celsum, ed. Paul Koetschau, Leipzig 1899 (First1K)
